# ReShip

> > ReShip is an international package forwarding service that enables customers worldwide to shop from US, UK, and Canadian retailers and ship products globally.

ReShip provides virtual addresses in the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada, allowing international customers to purchase from retailers like Amazon, Nike, Adidas, and Dick's Sporting Goods that may not ship directly to their countries. The service handles package consolidation, forwarding, and customs documentation for seamless global delivery.
